text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  lint-and-test-memory-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          activate-environment: true

      - name: Install memory-mcp dependencies
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: |
          uv sync --all-extras --dev

      - name: Lint memory-mcp
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: |
          uv run ruff check .

      - name: Test memory-mcp
        working-directory: memory-mcp
        run: |
          uv run pytest -v

  lint-wifi-cam-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          activate-environment: true

      - name: Install wifi-cam-mcp dependencies
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp
        run: |
          uv sync --all-extras --dev

      - name: Lint wifi-cam-mcp
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp
        run: |
          uv run ruff check .
```
